name: Henry Tuthill

updates.occupation: Justice of the Peace; landowner in Southold and Brookhaven

relationships.evidence: Akerly; family record in Horton Genealogy

bioAdditions: Son of John Tuthill (1635-1717) and Deliverance King, so a brother of John's 10th-great-grandfather John Tuthill Jr (John's 10th-great-granduncle, not a cousin). Akerly (S1) cites his will (N.Y. Liber 17, p. 118) and lists children Henry (1690), Jonathan (1695-1741, m. Susannah L'Hommedieu, granddaughter of Thomas Brinley, auditor to Charles I), Nathaniel (drowned 1727), Barnabas and Bethia (m. Samuel Landon). A family record (S2) says he died 4 Jan 1750 aged 84.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Akerly with will citation; replaces the McCurdy web pages as source.
